messages.content: The client moved Tuesday's first session to 9:00 a.m., so the Tuesday flight is out. Monday lodging is approved. Can we finish the Monday Delta flight and the Hampton for four nights together?

Yes. I have the Monday nonstop from Minneapolis to Raleigh departing at 7:05 p.m. and arriving at 10:38 p.m., with the Friday nonstop return departing Raleigh at 5:35 p.m. and arriving in Minneapolis at 7:24 p.m. The airfare is $548 round trip. For lodging, I have the Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh/Cary-I-40, checking in Monday, October 13 and checking out Friday, October 17, for four nights in a standard king room. Before purchase, I’ll verify the timing, complete price, and restrictions for both.
Keep that Friday return. Start with the airfare terms, especially whether this is basic economy and what happens if the trip changes.

The $548 fare is Delta Main Cabin, not Basic Economy. It includes a personal item, a carry-on, advance seat selection, and standard boarding. A checked bag is not included; the current first-bag charge is $35 each way if paid under the standard domestic allowance. The ticket is nonrefundable. Delta does not charge a change fee for this Main Cabin itinerary, but any fare difference applies. If canceled before departure, the ticket value is generally issued as an eCredit to the named traveler. Missing a flight without changing or canceling first can forfeit the remaining value.
Good. Is the $548 the final airfare, including taxes?
Yes. The fare breakdown is $487.44 in base fare and $60.56 in taxes and government fees, totaling $548.00. Optional checked bags, paid seat upgrades, and onboard purchases are separate.
Now calculate the hotel with tax. I don't want the four-night subtotal mistaken for the final amount.

The room charge is $179 per night for four nights, or $716.00. Estimated local and state lodging taxes are $94.87, bringing the expected hotel total to $810.87. There is no resort or destination fee listed. Breakfast, Wi-Fi, and self-parking are included, though parking will not matter if you use rideshare.
So airfare plus hotel is what?
The combined expected trip total is $1,358.87: $548.00 for the flights and $810.87 for the hotel. That excludes rideshare, meals beyond included breakfast, checked luggage, and hotel incidentals.
Please confirm the hotel cancellation deadline and what timezone controls it.

Free cancellation runs through Sunday, October 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time, which is the hotel’s local time. After that deadline, the listed penalty is one night’s room charge plus tax, approximately $202.72. A no-show is subject to the same stated one-night penalty, although the hotel can release the remaining nights if it is not notified of a late arrival.
The flight lands at 10:38 Monday night. Will that create a late-arrival problem?

It should not. Allowing for deplaning and the rideshare trip to Cary, a reasonable hotel arrival range is about 11:20 p.m. to midnight. I can add the flight number and a late-arrival note to the reservation. The front desk is open around the clock, and the card guarantee will hold the room overnight.
Check Tuesday morning too. Does this still give me enough margin for the 9:00 client session?

Yes. The Monday arrival gives you a full overnight buffer. From the Hampton to the Cary client site, the working estimate is 15 to 25 minutes by rideshare in Tuesday traffic. A pickup around 7:40 to 7:50 a.m. should put you at the office roughly between 8:00 and 8:20, leaving at least 40 minutes before the 9:00 session.
Use 7:40 as the pickup target in the trip notes. Is breakfast open early enough?
Yes. Breakfast begins at 6:00 a.m., so there is enough time before a 7:40 pickup. I’ve added that pickup target to the itinerary notes; it is not a scheduled rideshare reservation.
Before we proceed, are there any other restrictive terms or charges on the hotel?

The hotel is pay-at-property and does not require prepayment, but the corporate card will be used to guarantee the reservation. The property may place a temporary incidental authorization at check-in; that hold is not part of the $810.87 lodging estimate and is released according to the card issuer’s timing. The quoted rate is for one adult in a standard king room. Changes to dates or room type can trigger repricing, and the tax amount can change if local tax rates change before the stay.
Can the flight and hotel both go on the corporate card I have ready, even though the hotel isn't charging now?

Yes. The airline will charge $548.00 to the corporate card when the ticket is issued. The same card can guarantee the hotel now, with the estimated $810.87 charged by the property at checkout unless it applies an authorization at check-in. The traveler name on the airline ticket must exactly match the government-issued ID; the traveler and payment details currently entered are ready for final review.
Give me one final summary of what will be committed when I approve it.

Approval will issue one Delta Main Cabin round trip: MSP to RDU on Monday, October 13, 7:05 p.m. to 10:38 p.m., and RDU to MSP on Friday, October 17, 5:35 p.m. to 7:24 p.m., for a final airfare charge of $548.00. It will also reserve a standard king room at Hampton Inn & Suites Raleigh/Cary-I-40 from October 13 through October 17 for four nights, estimated at $810.87 including tax, payable at the hotel. The room can be canceled without penalty through October 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern; afterward, the stated penalty is approximately $202.72. The hotel reservation will include the Monday flight details and late-arrival note. Expected combined trip cost is $1,358.87 before ground transportation, checked bags, meals, and incidentals.
That all matches. Go ahead with both on the corporate card.

Both reservations are confirmed. Delta charged $548.00 to the corporate card for the Main Cabin round trip; the airline confirmation is D7K4QM. The Hampton reservation is guaranteed on the same card, with an estimated $810.87 due at the property; the hotel confirmation is 89427163. The late-arrival note includes the 10:38 p.m. flight arrival, and the trip notes show a 7:40 a.m. Tuesday rideshare target. The combined expected flight and hotel cost remains $1,358.87, and the hotel’s penalty-free cancellation deadline is Sunday, October 12 at 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time.
